title: multi run coord: a structured-coordination scenario of overlapping work, a refused claim and an answered ask, measured under coord shared against isolated
goal: multi run coord runs a scenario whose inputs in kb/_self/reports/multi_bench.csv give two code agents the same item, two research agents overlapping topics and one agent a question it asks another through kbask.py ask, which the other answers with kbask.py answer; its --dry-run names the shared item, the overlapping topics and the asking and asked agents under --coord shared and --coord isolated; and multi record writes for each run claims, claim_refused, conflicts_resolved, asks_answered, dup_facts, dup_commits and wasted_tokens, the tokens of an agent whose claim was refused or whose work another agent had already done

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import re, subprocess, sys
for co in ("shared", "isolated"):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", "multi", "run", "coord", "--dry-run", "--coord", co], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, ("multi run coord --dry-run --coord", co, r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-300:])
    items = re.findall(r"^agent \S+: code, .*?item (\S+)", r.stdout, re.M)
    assert len(items) >= 2 and len(set(items)) == 1, ("no two code agents share one item", co, items)
    areas = re.findall(r"^agent \S+: research, .*?area (\S+)", r.stdout, re.M)
    assert len(areas) >= 2, ("fewer than two research agents", co, areas)
    assert "kbask" in r.stdout and re.search(r"\bask", r.stdout), ("the dry run names no agent that asks another", co)

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); d = os.path.join(T, "m"); out = os.path.join(T, "b.csv")
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800)
try:
    r = bench("multi", "run", "coord", "--replay", "--dir", d)
    assert r.returncode == 0, ("multi run coord --replay", r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-300:])
    r = bench("multi", "record", "--dir", d, "--out", out)
    assert r.returncode == 0, ("multi record", (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-300:])
    m = {row["metric"] for row in csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding="utf-8")) if row["case"] == "coord"}
    miss = {"claims", "claim_refused", "conflicts_resolved", "asks_answered", "dup_facts", "dup_commits", "wasted_tokens"} - m
    assert not miss, ("multi record writes no coord row of", sorted(miss))
finally:
    bench("multi", "remove", "--dir", d)
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
